newsitem.title: USA: Value Health says MedPartners bid in January.
newsitem.headline: Value Health says MedPartners bid in January.

text.p: Value Health Inc said a MedPartners Inc takeover offer that it referred to in a news release earlier Tuesday had been made in January.

A statement from the company clarified the earlier statement in which Value Health announced revised merger terms in its planned transaction with Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp. In that statement, Value Health said it had received and rejected an offer from MedPartners.
In the latest release, Value Health said the MedPartners offer was made before it announced its merger agreement with Columbia/HCA on January 15.
